title: Sharps beside a note
summary: Accidentals: a sign that lasts one bar.

steps.title: A sharp beside a note
text: A sharp written just before one note is an **accidental**. It raises that note one fret.
It lasts until the end of the bar. The next bar line cancels it.

steps.title: Two new sharps
text: **C sharp** is the 2nd fret of the 2nd string. **G sharp** is the 1st fret of the 3rd string.
A sharp is always one fret above the plain note.

steps.title: One fret up
text: In bar 3 the sharp is written once, and the second C in that bar is sharp too.

steps.title: Sharps
text: Watch for sharps that carry through the bar.
